title: reportAbuse success status: Haven answers 201, mimid PeerClient accepts only 200; protocol-07 §5.9 names no code
description: Found live (B4 step 8), Haven 07ce96f. protocol-07 §5.9 L2731-2733: 'There is no response body. The response code only indicates if the abuse report was accepted' -- no status code is named (unlike §5.5 notify 201, §5.7 consent 202). mimi-hubd report_abuse_wire (mimi-hubd/src/http.rs L535-546) answers 201 Created and stores the report (checked in its abuse_reports table). mimid: PeerClient::report_abuse (crates/mimid-server/src/peer.rs L270) goes through post_read, which treats anything but 200 as PeerError::Rejected (decision mimid-1wgh.6.65 picked 200 for mimid's own hub, as an INVENTED choice since the draft is silent). Result: a report Haven accepted reads as rejected in mimid. Whose reading: neither contradicts the draft; the draft gap is the root (wg: name the success code, as §5.5 and §5.7 do). mimid-side follow-up (do not fix in this bead; mimid-server is being edited elsewhere): PeerClient::report_abuse should accept 201 as well (or any 2xx), with a decision bead amending .6.65. Haven: nothing to fix unless the WG picks 200.
